Re-run of the knee-vs-fixed BIC model comparison with a **looser, wider peak-fit
configuration**, to check whether the per-modality aperiodic-mode choice is
stable to the peak settings. Everything else matches
`bic_knee_vs_fixed_bootstrap_ci.qmd`: each normalized channel PSD is fit twice
(fixed and knee), scored with the Ameen-style BIC
[@ameen2025TemporallyResolvedAnalyses]
$$\mathrm{BIC} = N \log(\mathrm{MSE}) + n_p \log(N),$$
and the per-channel $\Delta\mathrm{BIC}=\mathrm{BIC}_\mathrm{knee}-
\mathrm{BIC}_\mathrm{fixed}$ is summarised with both a naive channel-level and an
honest subject-clustered percentile bootstrap. Inputs are the same verified
normalized-PSD tables; only the specparam peak settings differ:

```{python}
#| label: settings
#| echo: true
ALT_SPECPARAM_SETTINGS = dict(
    peak_width_limits=[1, 10],
    max_n_peaks=8,
    min_peak_height=0.15,
    peak_threshold=2.0,
)
```

```{python}
#| label: imports
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scipy.io as sio
from specparam import SpectralGroupModel
from IPython.display import Markdown
from plotnine import (
    aes,
    element_text,
    facet_grid,
    geom_errorbarh,
    geom_point,
    geom_vline,
    ggplot,
    labs,
    theme,
    theme_bw,
)

seed = 3
B = 10000
CI = 95
FREQ_RANGE = (1.0, 80.0)

PROJECT_DIR = Path("/Users/daniel/PhD/spectral-comparison/code/")
DATA_PATH_IEEG = PROJECT_DIR / "data/Frauscher2018"
specparam_dir = PROJECT_DIR / "data/interim/specparam_model_selection"
# Outputs go to a separate folder so the canonical model-selection files stay put.
out_dir = PROJECT_DIR / "data/interim/specparam_model_selection_alt_peakfit"
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
fig_dir = Path("figures")
fig_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

INPUT_CSV = {
    "iEEG atlas": specparam_dir / "specparam_input_normalized_psd_ieeg.csv",
    "source HD-EEG": specparam_dir / "specparam_input_normalized_psd_source_hd_eeg.csv",
}
```

```{python}
#| label: fit-bic
def load_psd_csv(path):
    """Split a saved normalized-PSD table into (psd_matrix, freqs, channel_names)."""
    df = pd.read_csv(path, index_col=0)
    num_cols = [c for c in df.columns if str(c).replace(".", "", 1).isdigit()]
    freqs = np.array([float(c) for c in num_cols])
    psd = df[num_cols].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    return psd, freqs, df.index.astype(str).to_numpy()


def fit_pair_bic(psd, freqs, channels, dataset, settings, freq_range=FREQ_RANGE):
    """Fit fixed and knee modes; Ameen-style per-channel BIC, R², MSE, MAE."""
    rows = []
    for mode in ("fixed", "knee"):
        fg = SpectralGroupModel(**settings, aperiodic_mode=mode, verbose=False)
        fg.fit(freqs, psd, freq_range=list(freq_range), n_jobs=1)
        ff = np.asarray(fg.data.freqs, dtype=float)
        n = ff.size
        for i, (channel, r) in enumerate(zip(channels, fg.results)):
            ap = fg.modes.aperiodic.func(ff, *np.asarray(r.aperiodic_fit, dtype=float))
            pp = np.asarray(r.peak_fit, dtype=float).ravel()
            peak = fg.modes.periodic.func(ff, *pp) if pp.size else 0.0
            residual = np.asarray(fg.data.power_spectra[i], dtype=float) - (ap + peak)
            mse = float(np.mean(residual**2))
            n_p = int(len(r.aperiodic_fit) + np.asarray(r.peak_fit).size)
            bic = n * np.log(max(mse, np.finfo(float).tiny)) + n_p * np.log(n)
            rows.append(
                {
                    "dataset": dataset,
                    "channel": channel,
                    "aperiodic_model": mode,
                    "bic": bic,
                    "gof_rsquared": r.metrics.get("gof_rsquared", np.nan),
                    "error_mae": r.metrics.get("error_mae", np.nan),
                    "mse_log10": mse,
                    "n_peaks": int(len(r.peak_fit)),
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


model_values = pd.concat(
    [
        fit_pair_bic(*load_psd_csv(path), dataset, ALT_SPECPARAM_SETTINGS)
        for dataset, path in INPUT_CSV.items()
    ],
    ignore_index=True,
)
model_values.to_csv(
    out_dir / "specparam_fixed_knee_model_values_by_channel.csv", index=False
)
```

```{python}
#| label: bootstrap-defs
def bic_evidence(delta_bic):
    """Raftery-style evidence categories for an absolute BIC difference."""
    delta_bic = abs(float(delta_bic))
    if delta_bic < 2:
        return "weak"
    if delta_bic < 6:
        return "positive"
    return "strong"


def add_subject(paired, ieeg_matfile=DATA_PATH_IEEG / "WakefulnessMatlabFile.mat"):
    """Attach the subject/patient cluster id to each channel."""
    paired = paired.copy()
    paired["subject"] = pd.NA

    is_hd = paired["dataset"] == "source HD-EEG"
    paired.loc[is_hd, "subject"] = (
        paired.loc[is_hd, "channel"].astype(str).str.split("_").str[0]
    )

    mat = sio.loadmat(ieeg_matfile, variable_names=["ChannelName", "Patient"])
    ch_names = [str(x[0][0]) for x in mat["ChannelName"]]
    patients = mat["Patient"].ravel()
    patient_of = {c: f"ieeg_p{p}" for c, p in zip(ch_names, patients)}
    is_ie = paired["dataset"] == "iEEG atlas"
    paired.loc[is_ie, "subject"] = (
        paired.loc[is_ie, "channel"].astype(str).map(patient_of)
    )

    assert paired["subject"].notna().all(), "unmapped channels"
    return paired


def paired_metrics(model_values):
    """Per-channel paired fixed/knee metrics: ΔBIC, ΔR², MSE ratio, + subject."""
    piv = model_values.pivot_table(
        index=["dataset", "channel"],
        columns="aperiodic_model",
        values=["bic", "gof_rsquared", "mse_log10"],
        aggfunc="first",
    ).reset_index()
    piv.columns = ["_".join(c).strip("_") for c in piv.columns]
    piv = piv.dropna(subset=["bic_fixed", "bic_knee"])
    piv["delta_bic"] = piv["bic_knee"] - piv["bic_fixed"]
    piv["delta_r2"] = piv["gof_rsquared_knee"] - piv["gof_rsquared_fixed"]
    piv["mse_ratio"] = piv["mse_log10_knee"] / piv["mse_log10_fixed"]
    return add_subject(piv)


def _percentiles(boot, ci):
    lo, hi = (100 - ci) / 2, 100 - (100 - ci) / 2
    return float(np.percentile(boot, lo)), float(np.percentile(boot, hi))


def bootstrap_channel(values, fn, B=B, ci=CI, seed=seed):
    """Naive channel-level percentile bootstrap of statistic ``fn``."""
    v = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    n = v.size
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    boot = np.array([fn(v[rng.integers(0, n, n)]) for _ in range(B)])
    lo, hi = _percentiles(boot, ci)
    return float(fn(v)), lo, hi


def bootstrap_cluster(values, subjects, fn, B=B, ci=CI, seed=seed):
    """Subject-clustered percentile bootstrap: resample whole subjects."""
    v = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    s = np.asarray(subjects)
    uniq = np.unique(s)
    groups = {u: v[s == u] for u in uniq}
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    boot = np.array(
        [
            fn(np.concatenate([groups[u] for u in rng.choice(uniq, uniq.size, True)]))
            for _ in range(B)
        ]
    )
    lo, hi = _percentiles(boot, ci)
    return float(fn(v)), lo, hi


STAT_DEFS = [
    ("median_delta_bic", "delta_bic", np.median),
    ("mean_delta_bic", "delta_bic", np.mean),
    ("median_delta_r2", "delta_r2", np.median),
    ("median_mse_reduction_pct", "mse_ratio", lambda x: (1.0 - np.median(x)) * 100.0),
]


def bootstrap_summary(paired):
    """Point estimate + channel CI + subject-clustered CI for each statistic."""
    rows = []
    for dataset, g in paired.groupby("dataset", observed=True):
        for name, col, fn in STAT_DEFS:
            point, c_lo, c_hi = bootstrap_channel(g[col], fn)
            _, s_lo, s_hi = bootstrap_cluster(g[col], g["subject"], fn)
            rows.append(
                {
                    "dataset": dataset,
                    "statistic": name,
                    "n_channels": int(len(g)),
                    "n_subjects": int(g["subject"].nunique()),
                    "point": point,
                    "channel_ci_lo": c_lo,
                    "channel_ci_hi": c_hi,
                    "subject_ci_lo": s_lo,
                    "subject_ci_hi": s_hi,
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def fit_quality_table(model_values):
    """Descriptive median fit metrics per dataset and aperiodic mode."""
    return (
        model_values.groupby(["dataset", "aperiodic_model"], observed=True)
        .agg(
            median_r2=("gof_rsquared", "median"),
            median_mse_log10=("mse_log10", "median"),
            median_mae=("error_mae", "median"),
            median_n_peaks=("n_peaks", "median"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )


def build_forest_plot(summary):
    """Forest plot of ΔBIC point estimates with channel vs subject CIs."""
    d = summary[summary["statistic"].isin(["median_delta_bic", "mean_delta_bic"])]
    long = pd.concat(
        [
            d.assign(ci_type="channel", ci_lo=d["channel_ci_lo"], ci_hi=d["channel_ci_hi"]),
            d.assign(ci_type="subject", ci_lo=d["subject_ci_lo"], ci_hi=d["subject_ci_hi"]),
        ],
        ignore_index=True,
    )
    long["statistic"] = long["statistic"].map(
        {"median_delta_bic": "median", "mean_delta_bic": "mean"}
    )
    return (
        ggplot(long, aes("point", "dataset"))
        + geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey")
        + geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin="ci_lo", xmax="ci_hi"), height=0.2)
        + geom_point(size=2.5)
        + facet_grid("statistic ~ ci_type", scales="free_x")
        + labs(
            x="ΔBIC (knee − fixed),  negative favours knee",
            y="",
            title=f"Alt peak-fit: bootstrap {CI}% CI of per-channel ΔBIC (B={B:,})",
        )
        + theme_bw()
        + theme(plot_title=element_text(size=10))
    )
```

```{python}
#| label: compute
paired = paired_metrics(model_values)
bic_bootstrap = bootstrap_summary(paired)
bic_fit_quality = fit_quality_table(model_values)

bic_bootstrap.to_csv(out_dir / "specparam_fixed_knee_bootstrap_ci.csv", index=False)
bic_fit_quality.to_csv(out_dir / "specparam_fixed_knee_fit_quality.csv", index=False)
```

## Selected model per modality (alt peak-fit)

```{python}
#| label: selected-mode-text
#| output: true
dbic = bic_bootstrap.set_index(["dataset", "statistic"])
lines = []
for dataset in ["iEEG atlas", "source HD-EEG"]:
    med = dbic.loc[(dataset, "median_delta_bic")]
    mean = dbic.loc[(dataset, "mean_delta_bic")]
    choice = "knee" if med["point"] < 0 else "fixed"
    lines.append(
        f"- **{dataset}** → **{choice}** "
        f"({int(med['n_subjects'])} subjects, {int(med['n_channels'])} channels). "
        f"median ΔBIC = {med['point']:.1f} "
        f"(subject CI [{med['subject_ci_lo']:.1f}, {med['subject_ci_hi']:.1f}]); "
        f"mean ΔBIC = {mean['point']:.1f} "
        f"(subject CI [{mean['subject_ci_lo']:.1f}, {mean['subject_ci_hi']:.1f}])."
    )
Markdown(
    "Negative ΔBIC favours knee; the mode is chosen by the sign of the median. "
    f"CIs are subject-clustered ({CI}% percentile bootstrap, B={B:,}).\n\n"
    + "\n".join(lines)
)
```
